name: Indo Count Industries Ltd
about: Indo Count Industries Limited (ICIL) is engaged in the home textiles & bedding industry. The company is a manufacturer and exporter of bed sheets, bed linen and quilts. [1] It is the  largest global bed linen player.
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Indo Count is the largest global home textile bed linen company specializing in bed sheets, fashion bedding, utility bedding, and institutional bedding.

cons: Dividend payout has been low at 14.4% of profits over last 3 years
